subject: POC blueprint & gating metrics — confirmation and next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@newpointe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC blueprint & gating metrics — confirmation and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the concrete next steps so we’re aligned before we draft the mutual action plan. I captured the metrics you asked for and proposed ownership / timelines below. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of scope
- Goal: Proof-of-concept to validate a live summarization pipeline for customer support transcripts (batch + streaming samples) with Redwood serving a dedicated model instance.
- Duration: 4 weeks (baseline pilot) + optional 2-week extension for durability testing.

Success criteria (what Newpointe needs to see to consider POC successful) — proposed
1) Latency: median tail (95th percentile) generation latency <= 220ms for 512-token outputs on a 2xA10 reserved instance under observed sample load.
2) Throughput: sustained 60 QPS (concurrent inference requests) with autoscale bursts to 120 QPS for spikes; no more than 1% request error rate.
3) Cost: target average cost <= $0.006 / generatedK-token (estimate; final cost split to be captured in MAP).
4) Quality: rouge-L F1 >= 0.62 vs. your labeled summary set (200 sample queries) and no more than 8% regression on our production prompt set compared to your baseline model.

Measurement & instrumentation
- We will instrument token-level latency and per-request KV cache hit-rate; Redwood console dashboards and a shared dashboard link will show real-time traces.
- QA: We’ll deliver a 200-sample evaluation pack (you already pointed to a subset) and run automated scoring each morning during the trial.

Ownership and timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): Contract sign + access: Newpointe to share sandbox dataset + procurement contact (Priya) — Mina to send MAP template attached.
- Week 1: Environment setup + smoke tests (Ben owner).
- Week 2: Run initial evaluation set; iterate model/config (Ben + Mina).
- Week 3: Scale run to sustained throughput; capture cost telemetry (Ben owner).
- Week 4: Readout and acceptance decision (Alex + Mina).

Attachments: I’ve attached a short success slate and a draft Mutual Action Plan to make the roles/timing explicit.

Immediate asks
- Alex: confirm the sample size and whether the 95th pct latency target is acceptable as a gating metric.
- Priya / procurement: if you can loop in contract team and share any standard NDAs/PO terms we should know about.

If that all looks good I’ll convert this into a MAP and propose 8/31 as a pilot kickoff (provisioning on 8/28).

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Subject: Re: POC blueprint & gating metrics — confirmation and next steps

Mina — thanks for the clear write-up. Quick replies inline.

Latency target: 95th <= 220ms is reasonable — priority is tail latency for the live agent use-case.
Throughput: 60 sustained QPS is fine; for the first week we’ll validate at lower load (20 QPS) then ramp.
Cost: the $0.006 / genK-token is aspirational — we’ll treat as a target. Pricing discussion to follow with procurement.
Quality: 200-sample set is fine. We’ll also add 50 live transcripts for edge-case checks.

Procurement: Priya, I’ve cc’d you — can you confirm NDA / PO cadence?

Confirm kickoff: 8/31 looks good for provisioning. Please send the MAP and we’ll review internally.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of AI Integrations, Newpointe Analytics
